scope.gradient: Coordinate covectors g_x=g_z/D. Uniform-volume Riesz density would divide by cell area; no such extra scaling used.
scope.complement: Orthogonal complement includes unused packed boundary coordinates, reported separately; not all irrotational fluid modes.
scope.forward: Full T4 solver/selected/reference only; solver/selected/final from three developed reference states for32intervals. Bases deduplicated.
scope.local: S(x) and C(S(x)) share identical initial physical state. Later independent trajectories are not local correction budgets.
scope.wall_flux: Zero by closed-face unpacking convention; packed normal padding checked separately, not inferred true native boundary flux.
scope.energy: Buoyancy may increase kinetic energy. Scalar variance and extrema increments are descriptive, not new admission gates.
scope.spectra: Orthonormal DCT-II packed-component power; no periodic eigenmode or continuous physical spectral-density claim.
